lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Can we race to that tree again? I'll choose a bigger one this time.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: Only if the finish line is outside the roots.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.text: Fine. Can it be between the roots?

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: Is it hard to see us when you're flying?

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: A little. I usually look for you on the path.

lines.speaker: Camille
lines.text: Next time I'll wave my scarf.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: I moved my bakery out of the path. You can come look.

lines.speaker: Umber
lines.text: I'll watch where I put my feet this time.

lines.speaker: Corinne
lines.text: Good. I just made a whole tray of pebble buns.
